title: Whoosh into hit
prompt:
Make a 2 s whoosh stinger sound effect for video at 30 fps.
Output: one WAV, 48 kHz / 16-bit / stereo, exactly 96000 samples.
Python + numpy/scipy only. Synthesise everything (no samples, no downloads). Fixed random seed.
Sound: band-pass noise sweep up into metallic hit at frame 30.
Master: −14 LUFS integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP.
Verify length, loudness, peak with ffmpeg ebur128; render spectrogram; fix until checks pass.
notes: Runner-verified synthesis (numpy). Prompt describes creative intent; code is executable.
